runs.cost_caveat: 9 of 10 dispatches vendor-reported. One event (plan_task_packets, $0.0850) is ESTIMATED: handled in-session on the same Opus tier the policy names, priced from the policy pricing block via the char/3.8 heuristic. Arm 4 of 4; cheapest of the four arms.
runs.headline_finding: The cheap tier cost MORE in absolute terms than the premium tier ($1.5813 vs $1.1256) despite being 2.4x cheaper per output token, because mechanical work emitted 3.3x more output. The two test packets alone were $0.9433 (35% of the run). A mixed policy pays off on input-heavy/output-light phases (review, analysis, planning) and pays off LEAST on test generation.
